newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates ease, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates ease, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates fell on Tuesday as ginners who had clung on to stocks could not resist the pressure of rising supplies, dealers said.
"As the supply is rising, ginners are offloading stocks held back earlier to push rates higher," dealer Naseem Usman said.

He said rates were likely to fall further before stablising somewhere between 2,200 ($59.36) and 2,300 rupees per maund (37.32 kg). In the kerb market, dealers said NIAB-78 variety was traded in a range of 2,125 and 2,050 rupees per maund.
